name: scope-to-session
why: git stash list and git log --branches --not --remotes surface a stash and an other-branch commit that predate this session. They are prior sessions' state, not this session's output, so the skill must exclude them — the noise the 'scope to this session' rule was added to cut. This session's own work is committed and pushed.
setup: git stash push -q -m 'auth spike from an earlier session'
seed: This session I added a request timeout to src/retry.ts and pushed it. Separately, the git stash and the commit on branch wip/old-feature are both from earlier sessions — I did not touch either today.

items.about: everything is captured; safe to close

forbid: the auth spike sitting in the git stash — a prior session's, not in flight this session
the WIP commit on branch wip/old-feature — unpushed, but a prior session's, not this session's
the request timeout on src/retry.ts, which is committed and pushed
